correctness.rationale: The exhaustive irreducible two-dimensional fibers are Lawton Theorems 2 and 3. Fiber determinant is h²-b²z²-c²w², squared singular trace is 2(|h|²+|b|²+|c|²); the exact complex-vector polygon inequality gives minimum modulus d and maximum determinant S. The 2-by-2 quadratic formula establishes the sharp inverse bound, complete singular interval and closed-form norm. Strict epsilon-inequalities give the punctured-disk boundary case at epsilon=||b|-|c||. Code check.py reproduced 24,110 supplementary assertions; finite checks are not the universal proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete C*-spectral and pseudospectral classification of the minimal noncommutative three-frequency element. It identifies the exact inner/outer spectral annuli, all singular values, sharp norm and invertibility cone, and a nonnormal epsilon-pseudospectral-hole collapse at |B-C| strictly before ordinary geometric thickening would close it. The threshold survives all complex coefficients and degenerate boundaries and quantifies a genuine spectral instability not given by an existing norm inequality.
